title: Large number of partner makes the product catalogue dashboard slow to load
author: JulienPalard
body_preview: The page at /catalogue/products/42/?#product_stock uses an HTML `<select>`  per stockrecord.  This is OK when there's either a small number of stockrecords per product or a small number of partners.
